basic_profile.bio: Avid Pokémon Go player and car enthusiast based in Chicago. I spend my weekends hunting for rare Pokémon and exploring new trails with my Jeep. I'm a software engineer by day, so I'm often online during the evenings and weekends. Married to my high school sweetheart, and we frequently team up for Pokémon raids. I dislike negativity online and prefer constructive discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Strong background in software development with a degree in Computer Science. Self-taught Pokémon Go strategies through extensive gameplay and participation in online communities. Also well-versed in car mechanics and modifications, thanks to hands-on experience with my Jeep.
